bot.owner: Root UI coordinator and Portal operator
bot.credentialsDestination: Portal protected bot registry only; never FamilyQuest

protectedCapture.startCondition: Fresh exclusive FamilyQuest UI lease after Menu and Master; start hidden private TTY input only inside that slot, because the helper holds the shared Portal deploy lock
protectedCapture.secretHandling: Token enters hidden TTY only, never argv, command history, logs, screenshots, chat or FamilyQuest configuration. No private capture script or duplicate service-key issuance.
protectedCapture.failureHandling: Existing token or registration requires reconciliation; never overwrite identity or blindly create another bot. Failed hidden input is retried through the same versioned helper.
protectedCapture.activationEffect: Capture/prepare/installation do not enable receiver, sender, product Telegram or consent. Installation publishes enabled=false and incomingMode=disabled.
protectedCapture.uiProofRequired: Verify the exact Main Mini App URL separately in BotFather; has_main_web_app does not prove its URL. Set menu button to the same URL.

keyHandoff.issuance: Existing or exactly one newly issued product-scoped key through Portal's regular service-key API; no duplicate issuance
keyHandoff.format: Raw key and optional trailing newline
keyHandoff.verification: GET /v1/telegram/readiness returns HTTP 200 and exact scope=portal_telegram, productId=familyquest using this key
keyHandoff.installationEffect: Atomically update protected .env; keep both flags false; never replace a different existing key or issue another key

runtime.recreateAccessCommand: docker compose -p familyquest -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.access.yml -f docker-compose.onboarding.yml up -d --no-deps --wait --wait-timeout 150 access
runtime.worker: In-process Access outbox, restart unless-stopped; durable PostgreSQL queue, 60-second leases, CAS settlement, capped retry delay, stable eventKey
runtime.workerStatusMeaning: Private transport diagnostic, exit 0 only when flags, fresh worker heartbeat and scoped Portal readiness are green. Not proof of local queue health or product/mobile acceptance.
runtime.queueStatusCommand: printf '%s\n' '{"familyId":1}' | docker compose -p familyquest -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.access.yml -f docker-compose.onboarding.yml exec -T provisioner familyquest-operator notification-status
runtime.scaleConstraint: One Access instance until ephemeral Telegram and persisted SSO session stores support shared state; SQL outbox leases do not make the entire gateway horizontally scalable

receiver.requirement: Exactly one versioned, supervised Portal polling receiver with durable cursor, DB lease, deduplication and fresh identity/heartbeat. No second getUpdates consumer, private polling script or parallel webhook.
receiver.registryPrerequisite: After verified disabled registration, Portal operator must publish the reviewed activation for familyquest only. telegram_credentials.py installs disabled; telegram_runtime.py requires the active exact registry and does not perform this registry transition.
receiver.providerPrerequisite: getWebhookInfo must confirm no active webhook. If an unexpected webhook exists, reconcile it through Portal before polling; preserve pending updates and cursor.
receiver.activationBoundary: Receiver-only operation belongs to Portal and must preserve TELEGRAM_FAMILYQUEST_DELIVERY_ENABLED=false, TELEGRAM_ENABLED=false and TELEGRAM_OUTBOX_ENABLED=false in FamilyQuest. Product UI and sender activation remain separate approval phases.
receiver.revocation: Portal processes /stop, blocked bot and unlink; checks exact binding again before enqueue and send. FamilyQuest cancels the revoked SQL generation on eligibility denial.
receiver.sender: Portal continuous sender owns Telegram API ambiguity, retries and delivery lease; FamilyQuest only enqueues the stable familyquest-UUID event. deliveredToPortal is not Telegram receipt.

actions: Back up database/configuration and retain previous images
Deploy CI-verified annotated release with flags false
Install exactly one scoped key after protected handoff
Verify public/Core/Access commit and health; run scoped readiness and SQL aggregates
exitCriteria: No private seed in build context
SaaS onboarding has no preloaded family/task/reward data
Scoped Portal check succeeds even if state is unconfigured/disabled; this is not production readiness

phases.approval: Pending: owner authorizes real Telegram UI activation for controlled accounts, without delivery
prerequisites: Verified bot identity and Main Mini App
Exactly one managed Portal polling receiver; scoped incoming.mode=polling and incoming.ready=true
Fresh exclusive shared Telegram UI lease
acceptance: Genuine signed initData and explicit issuer/subject binding
Parent and child PIN/role/family boundaries; inactive subscription denies writes
Real task completion and confirmation award once
Denied Telegram write permission never saves opt-in
BackButton, safe areas, phone layout, allowed deeplink hints
Unlink and session expiry deny subsequent access
Second controlled identity cannot read or modify the first family's data
phases.limitations: Ordinary browser PIN acceptance and synthetic SDK tests are not substitutes for these real Telegram checks

phases.approval: Pending: owner authorizes the continuous outbox and one neutral notification to an explicitly consenting controlled adult; never children or arbitrary customers
prerequisites: Portal exact product state=ready, ready=true, incoming/delivery ready; supervised continuous sender
No unresolved failed/uncertain deliveries in either queue
Current parental PIN, role, family access and explicit opt-in
acceptance: Close Mini App and let its real session expire, without shortening TTL or changing clocks
After expiry complete one authorized task and verify one neutral Telegram notification with stable eventKey and no duplicate reward
Verify /stop and unlink revoke delivery; new consent never replays the old cancelled generation
Restart Access and verify durable consent/queue plus fresh heartbeat
Remove temporary records and record observed Telegram result without credentials or personal child data

phases.approval: Pending: owner accepts the recorded UI, mobile, isolation, expiry and delivery results and authorizes permanent product delivery
prerequisites: Portal stage production, linked delivery, verified real bot, fresh receiver/sender
phases.action: Keep the approved true/true flags and supervised product transport; every future recipient still requires explicit consent and current family access

commands: runtime.queueStatusCommand for each family from the catalog
alertOn: Enabled worker heartbeat absent/stopped/stale or catalog/Core error
Portal state not ready, uncertain>0, recentFailed>0, oldestDueSeconds>300 or oldestSendingSeconds>30
Local failed>0, oldest pending older than 5 minutes while worker enabled, growing retries or repeated configuration errors
monitoring.disabledMode: Status exit 2 is expected when intentionally disabled; never convert disabled to healthy delivery. No automated activation.

triggers: Persistent errors or unknown delivery outcome
steps: Immediately disable only FamilyQuest delivery in Portal to stop already-enqueued messages; preserve the receiver so /stop still works
Run python3 scripts/telegram-control.py disable; it requires no Portal network access
Run runtime.recreateAccessCommand and verify both runtime flags false
Inspect local and Portal queues read-only; preserve IDs, leases, event keys and audit rows
If code rollback is needed, use the retained pre-release image IDs and compose/config backup; do not roll back migration 011/012 or restore an older database over current data
Reconcile uncertain deliveries before any later retry; do not create replacement event keys
